target.statement: AUC score of 0.7222 for the RODD-RF (y_RF) estimator in the simulation study, the best AUC among the five RODD methods
target.dataset: Synthetic data cubes (3,600 simulated 3-dimensional data cubes generated per the paper's procedure)

compute.basis: No code released; the full 3,600-cube simulation with 1,500-tree RFs (avg ~38 s, max ~26 min per cube) plus re-tuning on 120 cubes must be reimplemented from the text, likely taking hours on 8 CPU cores.

blockers: No code or configs released; entire simulation pipeline (data synthesis, 5 estimators, RF tuning, metrics) must be reimplemented from prose
Full protocol is 3,600 cubes with 1,500-tree RFs, expensive on CPU; exact AUC 0.7222 depends on unreleased random seeds and tuned hyperparameters
Real-world validation data (Table 4) is proprietary company data
title: RODD: Robust Outlier Detection in Data Cubes
